mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_LIZARD_KING (48), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_LIZARD = 36 (_enum.h:4186), so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster37.bmd. OpenMU Version075 Maps/Atlans.cs names breed 48 'Lizard King'. docs/atlans-port.md Part B 4.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13793-13798, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_LIZARD_KING: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_LIZARD); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_LIZARD, ...); Scale = 1.4f; Weapon[0] = MODEL_STAFF_OF_RESURRECTION. Link bones 52 and 65 (:11992-11995). RenderCharacter lights its eyes (RenderEye 42, 43) and hangs a spark and a shiny on bones 26, 31, 36 and 41 always (:11228-11238); its Lightning lets six BITMAP_JOINT_THUNDER off its two link bones to the target, three a hand, at Scale 50 and 10 (:2330-2342).
right_hand_from: Weapon[0], the Staff of Resurrection (Staff07, already cooked), on Weapon[0].LinkBone 52 -- knife_gdf in Monster37.
rig_from: Seven actions, exported with --actions=all. 79 bones. MONSTER_MODEL_LIZARD sets BoneHead 19 (Type 36) and no PlaySpeed (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3660-3669).
sheet_from: One sheet out of Data/Monster beside the model, decoded under a lizardking_ prefix: fr00.OZJ (256x256, all 1058 triangles) -- a tusked lizard-man in bronze-brown plated hide, a dark green scaled tail, gold bands.
sheet_materials_from: A plated, scaled hide is a shell, as the Budge Dragon's body: chitin, a little glossy.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3660-3669: SetMonsterSound(..., 138, 139, 138, 139, 140), offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210 -- 348 LIZARDKING1 (mLizardKing1.wav) and 349 LIZARDKING2 (mLizardKing2.wav) to move and to attack, 350 to die. 350 is SOUND_MONSTER_GORGONDIE_ (DSPlaySound.h:292), which nothing loads: the arm loads mGorgonDie.wav into SOUND_MONSTER_GORGONDIE instead, so MuMain's Lizard King dies silent. mGorgonDie is what the arm means, and is used. Wired as lizardking_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 7 islands for 1058 triangles, all fr00 and all chitin (the one sheet's plated hide). They arrived as skin.
